thought.text: Dev server compiled successfully. Let me confirm it serves HTTP on port 8080.

reasoning_content: The dev server compiled. Let me check if it's listening on 8080 and serve content. The timeout of 40s may already have ended. Let me start it again and curl.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup npm start > /tmp/devserver2.log 2>&1 & echo "pid=$!"; for i in $(seq 1 40); do sleep 2; if curl -sf -o /tmp/qm.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; done; echo "---title---"; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/qm.html; echo "---bytes---"; wc -c /tmp/qm.html; echo "---port---"; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080

tool_call.name: terminal
